message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in way to do a wildcard search directly, so I’ll give you the shell commands you can run yourself:

```bash
# 1️⃣ Find everything that has “test” somewhere in the filename
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*test*'

# 2️⃣ Make the backup folder (if it doesn’t already exist)
mkdir -p backup_tests

# 3️⃣ Copy each matching file into that folder
for f in $(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*test*'); do
    cp "$f" backup_tests/
done
```

That will leave a `backup_tests` directory in your current folder containing copies of all the files whose names contain “test”, regardless of case. Let me know if you’d like me to run any of those steps for you.
